hypotheses.statement: Methionine at position 39 is strongly favored; most top variants carry V39M.
Glycine at position 40 with alanine at 41 is the dominant beneficial pair.
Alanine at position 54 is preferred over wild-type valine in the best scaffolds.
Diverse non-M/G/A variants will score low but map epistatic boundaries.

reasons.MGLA: Top model pick; combines V39M with G41L, a known beneficial context.
reasons.MAAA: Tests whether D40A rivals D40G within the M-A-A scaffold.
reasons.MDAA: Probes deletion of position 40 effect versus full-length variants.
reasons.MYAA: Aromatic D40Y test; checks position 40 tolerance for bulky residues.
reasons.EGAA: Swaps V39M for E39 to test position 39 specificity.

hypotheses.statement: Methionine at position 39 is the dominant driver; M39 variants will outperform I39/L39/F39/Y39 alternatives.
Small residues (G, A, S, N) at position 40 with G41A/V54A will beat bulky aromatics like W and F.
Alanine at position 54 is strongly preferred; V54A variants will exceed V54G/V54W scaffolds.
Diverse non-M/G/A variants will score low but reveal epistatic boundaries for the next model.

reasons.IWAA: I39 with W40 tests whether W40 rescues I39 scaffold; model top.
reasons.IRAA: I39/R40 probes arginine at 40 on I39 backbone; high model rank.
reasons.IAAA: I39/A40 baseline for I39 series; calibrates position-40 effect.
reasons.LWAA: L39/W40 tests leucine vs isoleucine at 39 with W40.
reasons.WQLG: Explores G41L/V54G epistasis with W39/Q40; boundary mapping.

hypotheses.statement: Position 39 aromatic/small residues (F, Y, W, A) with D40W/G41A/V54A will exceed polar/charged 39 residues.
Bulky hydrophobic at position 40 (W, F, Y, I, L) will outperform small polar residues given G41A/V54A.
G41A with V54A is strongly preferred; variants retaining both will dominate the batch mean.
Diverse non-A41 variants will score low but map epistatic boundaries for the next model.

reasons.VIAA: Top model pick; I40 hydrophobic bulk with G41A/V54A.
reasons.VHAA: H40 polar-bulky probe near top rank; tests 40 chemistry.
reasons.VFAA: F40 aromatic bulk; known F40W strong, tests F vs W.
reasons.AWAA: A39 with W40 tests whether small 39 plus bulky 40 synergizes.
reasons.PWAA: P39 rigid probe with W40; tests 39 backbone constraint effect.

hypotheses.statement: M39 with small-to-medium hydrophobic at 40 and A at 41/54 will exceed wild type and approach MGAA.
Aromatic or large hydrophobic at position 40 (Y, F, L, W) improves packing beyond glycine at 40.
Charged/polar residues at 54 (E, K, R, Q, N) are deleterious relative to alanine at 54.
The EQL motif at 39-41 is a strong alternative backbone context; its fitness depends mainly on position 54 identity.

reasons.MGLA: Top model pick; M39+G40+L41+A54 combines best-known motif with L41.
reasons.MYAA: Tests aromatic Y40 packing; high structure prior, distinct from glycine at 40.
reasons.MLAA: Large hydrophobic L40 probes packing limit at most exposed site.
reasons.MGGA: Deletion of G41 tests whether turn length matters for binding.
reasons.VQLA: Wild-type 39 with QL turn; high structure prior, tests EQL motif without E39.

hypotheses.statement: M39 combined with aromatic/large hydrophobic at 40 (W, R, F) exceeds wild type and rivals MWAA.
At position 40, W and R outperform A and S when paired with M39 and A at 41/54.
I39 with W at 40 will underperform M39/W40, showing position 39 prefers methionine over isoleucine.
Non-alanine at 41 or 54 (L, G, E, R) reduces fitness relative to the A/A backbone.

reasons.IWAA: I39 with W40 tests whether W40 dominates; high structure prior.
reasons.IRAA: R40 with I39 probes charged-at-40 effect vs W40.
reasons.LWAA: L39/W40 contrasts position 39 identity at fixed W40.
reasons.VWAA: Wild-type 39 with W40 isolates position-40 W benefit.
reasons.WQLG: Exploratory non-A backbone at 41/54 to test epistasis.

hypotheses.statement: Aromatic residues at position 40 (W, F, Y) with A at 41/54 give the highest fitness, exceeding 6.0.
Position 39 prefers small or alanine-like residues (A, V, I, L) over charged/polar when 40 is aromatic.
Non-alanine at position 41 (P, R, K, C) reduces fitness relative to the A/A backbone.
At position 54, alanine remains optimal; W, F, or charged substitutions lower fitness.

reasons.VIAA: Top model rank; I40 hydrophobic bulk with A backbone exploits known W/F40 gains.
reasons.VHAA: H40 polar-aromatic may add H-bond; high structure prior, tests 40 chemistry.
reasons.VFAA: F40 aromatic matches top known FWAA/FYAA motif, strong exploitation.
reasons.VYAA: Y40 aromatic, high structure prior; probes whether Y rivals F/W at 40.
reasons.AWAA: A39 with W40 tests whether small 39 plus aromatic 40 beats FWAA.

hypotheses.statement: Tryptophan at position 40 drives high IgG-Fc binding enrichment.
Phenylalanine at position 41 is favored over wild-type glycine.
Alanine at position 39 is broadly tolerated and often improves fitness.
Threonine at position 54 outperforms alternative residues at that site.

reasons.AWCT: Top model pick; tests cysteine at 41 versus known AWFT winner.
reasons.AWMT: Top-ranked; probes methionine at 41 for hydrophobic packing.
reasons.AWAT: Tests alanine at 41, isolating position-41 contribution.
reasons.AHFT: Histidine at 40 with phenylalanine at 41; alternative polar-40 probe.
reasons.ASFT: Serine at 40 tests whether smaller polar residue retains binding.

hypotheses.statement: Histidine at position 40 combined with leucine at 41 yields high enrichment, as WHLT and LHLT show.
Tryptophan at position 39 is strongly favored; W39 variants dominate the top measured fitness values.
Glycine at position 54 is favored over threonine when paired with W39 and F41.
Alanine at position 41 with cysteine at 54 (FYAC-like) can yield high enrichment.

reasons.WHFT: Model top; tests H40 with F41, bridging WWFT and WHLT winners.
reasons.WWFG: Tests glycine at 54 with W39/W40/W41, probing site-54 preference.
reasons.AHFG: Alanine scaffold with H40/F41/G54, exploring non-W39 high-fitness route.
reasons.FYAC: Known high-fitness A41/C54 motif; shortlist analog QYAC tests its generality.
reasons.WWLT: W40 with L41; tests whether W40 only fails when paired with F41.

hypotheses.statement: Tryptophan at position 39 is strongly favored; W39 variants dominate top measured fitness.
Glycine at position 54 is favored over threonine when paired with W39 and F41.
Aromatic/charged residues at position 40 (W, R, F) boost enrichment beyond aliphatic residues.
Phenylalanine at position 41 paired with W39 and T54 yields high enrichment.

reasons.WIFG: Top model pick; tests isoleucine at 40 with W39/F41/G54.
reasons.WRFG: Arginine at 40 with F41/G54 probes charged polar effect.
reasons.WWFP: Proline at 54 tests whether WWF core tolerates rigid turn.
reasons.FRLT: F39/R40/L41/T54 tests non-W39 scaffold with charged 40.
reasons.YAFT: Diverse Y39/A40/F41/T54 probes alternate backbone at high prediction.

hypotheses.statement: Aromatic substitution at position 40 (W/F/Y) drives the largest gains, consistent with the known AWFT top variant.
Position 41 tolerates diverse residues but F is enriched among top variants; L at 41 may also be favorable.
Position 39 substitutions are largely neutral-to-mild; A is common but W/I may add packing gains.
V54T is near-optimal; alternative 54 residues (A/C/S) likely reduce fitness relative to T.

reasons.AWAT: Model top with best structure prior among AWxT; tests position 41 A vs F.
reasons.VWFT: Highest structure prior (1.98) among W40/F41 variants; tests 39 wild-type retention.
reasons.VHFT: Top structure prior (2.01); tests H40/F41 without 39 mutation.
reasons.AWRT: High structure prior (0.68) with R41; probes charge at 41.
reasons.VHKT: Highest structure prior (3.11); tests K41 charge in H40 background.

hypotheses.statement: Aromatic residues at position 40 (W, H, F, Y) drive the largest fitness gains, consistent with WWFT and WHLT tops.
Position 41 F is strongly enriched among top variants; L at 41 is a viable alternative that may pair well with W40.
Position 39 W combined with aromatic 40 and F41 yields the highest measured fitness; W39 is the key core-packing anchor.
V54T is near-optimal; non-T at 54 (A/C/G/S) reduces fitness relative to T in this background.

reasons.WHFT: Top model pick; W39/H40/F41 aromatic stack with V54T, closest to WWFT.
reasons.WVFT: W39/F41 with V40 tests whether aromatic 40 is required for gain.
reasons.LHFT: L39/H40/F41 probes whether W39 is essential vs H40-driven gain.
reasons.VSFT: Wild-type 39/40 with F41/T54; high structure prior, tests 41/54 alone.
reasons.WWLT: W40 with L41 tests whether F41 is required or L41 is a viable alternative.

hypotheses.statement: W39 with aromatic 40 and F41 is the dominant fitness motif; V54T is best but V54G/A retain high activity.
At position 54, T and G outrank charged/polar residues (D/E/K/R) in W39-aromatic40-F41 backgrounds.
Position 40 tolerates diverse residues; bulky aromatics (W,F,Y) and H give the largest gains over small polar residues.
L at position 41 paired with W40 and T54 can rival F41, as seen in WWLT and WRLT tops.

reasons.WIFG: Top model pick; I40 with W39/F41 tests bulky-aliphatic at exposed 40.
reasons.WRFA: V54A with W39/R40/F41 probes whether A54 rivals G54 in arginine background.
reasons.WWFP: Proline at 54 tests backbone-rigidity epistasis against incumbent WWFG.
reasons.WRGT: High structure prior; tests R40 with native-like 41G and T54.
reasons.WWGT: High structure prior; W40 with 41G/T54 tests glycine-turn compatibility.

hypotheses.statement: Tyrosine at position 39 drives high binding, as seen in top variant YRGS.
Asparagine at position 40 combined with V54S boosts fitness above wild type.
Serine at position 54 is favorable when paired with aromatic position 39 residues.
Cysteine at position 41 with alanine at 39 is neutral-to-harmful versus wild type.

reasons.YNGS: Top model pick; tests Y39N40S54 synergy seen in best known YRGS.
reasons.AGCG: Probes whether A39/G41C/V54G scaffold rivals Y39 backbone.
reasons.YQGS: Tests polar D40Q versus known D40N within Y39/V54S context.
reasons.YCGS: Cysteine at 40 tests whether small thiol helps or hurts binding.
reasons.YYGS: Aromatic-aromatic D40Y tests stacking hypothesis at position 40.

hypotheses.statement: Alanine at position 39 combined with cysteine at 41 is strongly favorable, as AICA and AWCG show.
Glycine at position 54 with cysteine at 41 outperforms serine at 54 among top variants.
Aromatic position 40 residues (W, Y, F) boost fitness when paired with G41C and V54G.
Isoleucine at position 40 with G41C and V54A yields high binding, as AICA suggests.

reasons.AWCA: Top model pick; A39/C41/G54 scaffold matches best known AICA.
reasons.FYGS: Aromatic 39/40 with V54S; explores S54 branch near top known YYGS.
reasons.FWCG: F39/W40 with C41/G54; tests aromatic 39 on proven G54 scaffold.
reasons.AWFG: A39/W40 with F41/G54; probes whether F41 rivals C41 at 41.
reasons.VWCG: Wild-type 39 with W40/C41/G54; isolates position-40 tryptophan benefit.

hypotheses.statement: Aromatic position 40 (W/Y/F) with G41C and V54A boosts fitness above aliphatic 40 residues.
Cysteine at 41 paired with alanine at 54 outperforms glycine at 54 across position-39 backgrounds.
Small/polar position 39 residues (A, S, T) with D40N and G41C yield high binding.
Positions 39 and 40 interact epistatically; best 39 depends on the 40 identity.

reasons.LICA: Top model rank; tests L39 with I40/C41/A54 combination.
reasons.TICA: Polar T39 with I40 probes 39-40 epistasis at high rank.
reasons.MNCA: N40 with M39 tests polar-40 alternative to aromatic boost.
reasons.MYCA: Aromatic Y40 with M39 tests aromatic-40 hypothesis directly.
reasons.WYCA: W39/Y40 double aromatic probes strongest aromatic pairing.

hypotheses.statement: Y at position 39 combined with S at 54 drives high fitness, as seen in top variant YRGS.
Position 40 tolerates diverse residues; N, R, and G at 40 may each support high fitness in YxGS backgrounds.
The A-C-G motif at 39/41/54 (A39, C41, G54) is a strong alternative scaffold to YxGS.
Diverse low-predicted variants will reveal whether the model misses non-additive beneficial combinations.

reasons.YNGS: Top model pick; Y39/N40/S54 combination near known best YRGS.
reasons.AGCG: Second model pick; tests A39/C41/G54 scaffold as alternative to YxGS.
reasons.YQGS: Y39/Q40/S54; Q40 polar substitution probes position-40 tolerance.
reasons.IRGS: I39/R40/S54 with high structure prior; tests non-Y position 39.
reasons.VNGM: Wild-type 39/41 with N40/M54; high structure prior, tests 54M effect.

hypotheses.statement: A39 with C41 and G54 forms a high-fitness scaffold; position 40 identity modulates but does not break it.
W at position 40 is broadly beneficial across 39/41/54 backgrounds, as seen in AWCG and AWCA.
F39 with Y40 and S54 (FYGS) is a strong alternative scaffold rivaling A-C-G.
I at position 40 paired with C41/G54 supports high fitness, per AICA and AILG.

reasons.AWCA: Top model pick; A-C-G scaffold with W40, tests W40 benefit.
reasons.FYGS: High structure prior; tests F39/Y40/S54 alternative scaffold.
reasons.FWCG: W40 with F39 and G54; probes W40 across a different 39/54 context.
reasons.IYGS: Highest structure prior; tests I39/Y40/S54 combination.
reasons.VWCG: Wild-type 39 with W40/C41/G54; isolates W40 effect without A39.

hypotheses.statement: A39 paired with C41 and A54 (ANCA-like) is the dominant high-fitness scaffold; position 40 identity modulates but rarely breaks it.
Aromatic residues at position 40 (W, Y, F) boost fitness on A39/C41/A54 backgrounds, as in AWCA and AYCA.
C41 with G54 (CG) supports high fitness when paired with hydrophobic 39/40, per LWCG and VWCG.
I at position 40 is context-dependent and often neutral-to-deleterious, so I40 variants should be deprioritized relative to aromatic 40.

reasons.LICA: Top model pick; L39/I40 hydrophobic packing with C41/A54 scaffold.
reasons.MYCA: Aromatic Y40 plus M39; high structure prior, tests aromatic-40 hypothesis.
reasons.VYCA: Wild-type 39 with Y40; clean test of aromatic-40 benefit on A54 scaffold.
reasons.LWCA: L39/W40 with C41/A54; probes W40 benefit seen in AWCA.
reasons.VACA: Wild-type 39/40 with C41/A54; baseline for scaffold effect.
